payload.description_html: The holotype of Daniatrogon kochi (MM-14981) from the early Eocene Fur Formation in Denmark. A, specimen coated with ammonium chloride; B, specimen with matrix digitally removed and fish remains brightened. Major bones are labelled. Abbreviations: atl, atlas; cbr, ceratobranchial; fsh, fish bones; lac, lacrimal; lcm, left carpometacarpus; lfe, left femur; lhu, left humerus; lsc, left scapula; ltb, left tibiotarsus; ltm, left tarsometatarsus; lul, left ulna; mdb, mandible; pel, pelvis; ptg, pterygoid; qdr, quadrate; rfe, right femur; rhu, right humerus; rsc, right scapula; rtb, right tibiotarsus; rtm, right tarsometatarsus; rul, right ulna; scl, scleral plates; sku, skull; vrt, vertebra. Scale bar: 10 mm.
